info.title: Bastion MCP (Health) Server
info.description:
Health endpoints for the Bastion Model Context Protocol (MCP) server. The MCP server supports both stdio and Streamable HTTP transports, providing 8 tools, 4 resources, and 3 prompts to AI agents.

Tools: `memory_search`, `memory_store`, `memory_timetravel`, `memory_audit`, `memory_heal`, `memory_delete`, `resolve_conflict`, `a2a_bridge`.

Resources: `bastion://schema`, `bastion://config`, `bastion://stats`, `bastion://memory/{memory_id}`.

This HTTP server provides health check endpoints for container orchestration and load balancers.

get.description: Returns 200 OK when the MCP server process is running.
Returns 200 OK when the MCP server is ready to process tool calls (DB connected or mock mode).

ApiKeyAuth.description: API key via `BASTION_API_KEY` environment variable. Send as `Authorization: Bearer <key>`.

x-mcp-tools.description: These tools are available via MCP stdio (subprocess) or Streamable HTTP transport. Agent frameworks connect to the MCP server via stdio or HTTP.

tools.name: memory_search
tools.description: C-SPANN vector search over agent memories with decay-weighted scoring. Returns semantically relevant memories with trust scores and provenance data.

tools.name: memory_store
tools.description: SHA-256 hash-chained memory storage. Embeds content via AWS Bedrock Titan V2, computes hash over previous chain head, stores in CRDB with full provenance.

tools.name: memory_timetravel
tools.description: Point-in-time queries using CockroachDB `AS OF SYSTEM TIME` for historical memory analysis and audit reconstruction.

tools.name: memory_audit
tools.description: Append-only immutable audit log with cryptographic hash chain verification. Every operation is recorded with agent ID, action, and chain hash.

tools.name: memory_heal
tools.description: CDC-triggered self-healing pipeline that detects hash chain gaps, re-runs embeddings on corrupted entries, and restores chain integrity.

tools.name: memory_delete
tools.description: Delete a single memory by ID with confirmation flag. Uses CockroachDB SERIALIZABLE isolation for safe concurrent deletion.

tools.name: resolve_conflict
tools.description: Multi-agent conflict resolution using SERIALIZABLE isolation level. Uses CRDT merge strategies and lease consensus to resolve concurrent writes.

tools.name: a2a_bridge
tools.description: Retrieve the A2A Agent Card for inter-agent discovery. Returns A2A-compliant metadata including capabilities and protocol version.
